inspection. Every finding uses its own worktree; staged and unstaged patches,
untracked files and commits are retained per attempt before retry or fallback.
evidence.reason: The README contains the asserted inconsistency: the runtime ownership section says repair "uses one worktree per item and serial findings within that item", while the recovery section says "Every finding uses its own worktree". Because an item can contain multiple findings, the two descriptions conflict and leave retained-patch ownership ambiguous for recovery.
